2610.07261.title: Verifying Coordination in Parallel Coding Agents: NP-Bench and a Scheduling Planner
2610.07261.paper_summary: A team of coding agents can look fine agent by agent yet fail as a team: each passes its own tests while the merged result is broken, and single-agent evaluation never catches it. As teams run several LLM coding agents in parallel on one codebase, the agents collide: two rewrite the same function, one codes against a contract a teammate just changed, and integration fails after the work is done. Most coordination tools react (watch for a conflict, then warn), but at agent speed the warning arrives after the wasted edit. We recast the problem as scheduling: take each work item's declared scope, partition the work into disjoint scopes, and order merges along the producer->consumer graph, all up front. We build this planner into Nerveplane and evaluate it with NP-Bench, an environment-grounded three-arm benchmark (no coordination; reactive detection; proactive planning) that verifies integration off a real git merge, both in a deterministic simulation and with live agents. The planner lifts clean-integration from 1/9 to 9/9 scenarios and cuts merge conflicts from 13 to 0, with a gap that grows in the number of agents. On a live breaking contract change it rescues an outcome both baselines miss on every seed: the clean-integration rate rises from 0 (no coordination and reactive detection) to 1.0 on a frontier model and 0.6 on a small one, while agents respect assigned scopes (0/5 leakage). A cross-session memory drops the repeated-mistake rate from 1.00 to 0.00 on strong and weak models alike. We also report a negative result: routing facts to agents does not rescue long-context accuracy at window-fitting scales; its value is cost and capacity, not attention. Across two capability tiers and two vendors, the benefit did not shrink as models got stronger, because it comes from how work is allocated, not model reasoning.
2610.07261.paper_summary_zh: 一組編碼代理可能逐個看起來都很好，但作為一個團隊卻失敗：每個代理通過自己的測試，但合併的結果卻是壞的，而單一代理的評估從未發現這一點。當團隊在同一代碼庫上並行運行多個 LLM 編碼代理時，代理之間會發生衝突：兩個代理重寫相同的函數，一個代理針對剛剛被隊友更改的合約進行編碼，而集成在工作完成後失敗。大多數協調工具都會反應（監視衝突，然後發出警告），但在代理速度下，警告在浪費的編輯之後才到達。我們將這個問題重新表述為調度：取每個工作項目聲明的範圍，將工作劃分為不相交的範圍，並在生產者->消費者圖上預先排序合併。我們將這個規劃器構建到 Nerveplane 中，並使用 NP-Bench 進行評估，這是一個基於環境的三臂基準（無協調；反應性檢測；主動規劃），它驗證基於真實 git 合併的集成，無論是在確定性模擬中還是與實時代理一起進行。該規劃器將乾淨集成的場景從 1/9 提升到 9/9，並將合併衝突從 13 減少到 0，隨著代理數量的增加，差距也在擴大。在一次實時的破壞性合約變更中，它挽救了一個所有基線在每個種子上都錯過的結果：乾淨集成率從 0（無協調和反應性檢測）上升到 1.0 在前沿模型上，和 0.6 在小型模型上，而代理則遵守分配的範圍（0/5 漏出）。跨會話記憶將重複錯誤率從 1.00 降至 0.00，無論是在強模型還是弱模型上。我們還報告了一個負面結果：將事實路由到代理並未在窗口擬合尺度上挽救長上下文的準確性；它的價值在於成本和容量，而非注意力。在兩個能力層級和兩個供應商之間，隨著模型變得更強大，這一好處並未縮小，因為它來自於工作分配的方式，而不是模型推理。
2610.07261.author: Sumanyu Muku et.al.
